summary: Iter-118 P10 — Opname & keuangan (WM-07, WM-08, FN-14, RF-17) + saran tindakan gate (ACTIONS) + riwayat passage + peringatan klaim printer. BACKEND: 8/8 PASSED di /app/backend/tests/test_iter118_p10.py (HTTP /api). Service-level audit `repro_p10.py` 21/21 juga hijau. WM-07: expected per-bin (binA=40, binB=60), duplicate key 409, campur level warehouse+bin 409, actual negatif/NaN ditolak 400 (bukan 500), binB 60/60 → 1 discrepancy, approve binA 40→30 tanpa double-reduction. FN-14: kurang 10@100 → journal Dr 5-9500 1.000 / Cr 1-1300 1.000; approve ulang → 400 tanpa journal dobel; surplus → roll baru dengan unit_cost=WAC segmen (80.0) + Dr 1-1300 400; zero-cost tanpa reason → 409 (sesi tetap submitted, saga_lock release); dengan zero_cost_reason → 200 dan tersimpan di items[].adjustment. WM-08: picked (10 available + 30 picked) → expected 40, actual 0 → applied=-40 unresolved=0 status=applied, semua roll habis; drift keluar scope setelah submit → 409 tanpa mutasi, sesi tetap submitted. Gate: /api/rfid/gate/simulate dan /api/rfid/ingest sekarang mengandung field `action` (saran tindakan Indonesia); GET /api/rfid/passages?device_id=|warehouse_id= mengembalikan {passages:[{id,verdict,red_count,green_count,reads[{roll_no,result,action}],acknowledged_by,acknowledged_at,acknowledge_note}], next_before}. Setelah acknowledge, baris passage menampilkan acknowledged_by/at + note. RF-17: /rfid/tags/encode diizinkan untuk roll WIP; /rfid/cycle-count/start → expected mencakup WIP ber-tag tapi EXCLUDES in_transit_sales; scan via /rfid/verify-sessions/{id}/scan (source=manual); /rfid/cycle-count/{id}/complete menghasilkan accuracy_pct<100 saat ada EPC asing + semua metrik (eligible_count, tagged_count, untagged_count, tag_coverage_pct, read_recall_pct, extra_rate_pct, unresolved_count). FRONTEND: Gate Monitor ?view=cs-rfid-gate dimuat utuh (rfid-gate-view/select/simulate), rfid-passage-history menampilkan dua baris passage dengan rfid-passage-ack-info-<id> ('Diakui Budi Santoso · 01 Okt, 09.51') + rfid-passage-note-<id> ('Catatan: cek fisik oleh satpam'). Tag/Verifikasi ?view=cs-rfid-tags → rfid-tab-print → setelah seed job dengan lease ~45s dan print_attempts=3: badge rfid-job-lease-<id> data-low='1' dengan teks 'HAMPIR HABIS', badge rfid-job-retry-<id> 'Diulang 3× — cek printer', dan modal rincian menampilkan rfid-job-detail-lease 'sudah diulang 3× — cek printer/media label'.
critical_code_review_comments: services/stock_count_service.py: scope_qty + _scope_q konsisten dengan on_hand (status in PHYSICAL_ROLL_STATUSES, length_remaining>0, bin optional) — definisi tunggal eliminates WM-07 inkonsistensi; count_key enforces unique (product, owner, bin) & 409 saat campur level warehouse+bin; SHORTAGE_ORDER cover semua bucket fisik.

services/stock_count_service: surplus_unit_cost strategi berlapis (WAC bin → WAC product/warehouse → WAC product/owner → biaya standar) dicatat eksplisit di modul docstring; zero-cost HARUS reason untuk mencegah valuasi 0 diam-diam (409) — sesuai FN-14.
routers/cycle_count.py add_item/update_item: enforce actual_qty finite (reject NaN) + non-negative, mengubah 500 → 400 untuk input invalid.

services/gl_service.post_cycle_count_variance: idempoten per source_id=f'{session}:{item}', approve ulang→400 tanpa journal dobel; akun 5-9500/1-1300/4-9000 konsisten; releases saga_lock saat raise 409.

services/gate_evaluator.ACTIONS: mapping dari code → kalimat tindakan Indonesia (satu baris, bahasa lapangan) menjadikan pesan gate immediately-actionable untuk satpam; _v melekatkan action ke setiap result (ingest + simulate).

services/rfid_ingest_service.list_passages: project out epcs (muatan besar) + hydrate reads[{roll_no, result, action}] via single $in query → O(1) round-trip. Cursor by last_at mendukung pagination 'before' + next_before.

services/cycle_count_service (RF-17): PHYSICAL_STATUSES disinkronkan dari roll_service → WIP ber-tag ikut expected, in_transit_sales tidak; metrik dipecah (coverage vs recall vs extra vs unresolved) sehingga akurasi observable per-penyebab.

frontend/features/rfid/RfidPrintVerifyPanel.jsx: leaseInfo menghitung sisa klaim via live interval (1s) dan menandai low saat ≤60 detik; RetryBadge saat print_attempts>2 dengan testid rfid-job-retry-<id>; rfid-job-detail-lease menyebut 'sudah diulang Nx' sesuai permintaan.

frontend/features/rfid/GatePassageHistory.jsx + GateLiveVerdict.jsx: toggle expand per baris menampilkan reads[].action (rfid-passage-action-<readId>) sehingga satpam melihat saran tindakan di tiap roll; ack info ditampilkan sebagai 'Diakui <nama> · <waktu>' atau 'Belum diakui'.

frontend/features/inventory/CycleCount.jsx: cc-adj-<itemId> + cc-adj-journal-<itemId> + cc-zero-cost-reason-input semua terbukti ada di source (lines 401/438/444) — UI siap menampilkan ringkasan adjustment per item & input alasan zero-cost.
